quotes.text: Who received, and believed, and repented likewise, And then were baptised as a man always was, — Who asked and received a remission of sin.

I know we live in the kingdom of God and serve a liberal Master, and though we may be called upon to make what we may view as sacrifices, if we do so willingly and liberally, God will give to us a liberal reward. “The liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand,” was said b
